description: Unknit - Code review tool for rapidly reviewing AI-generated code through scannable hierarchical outlines

userStories.title: Initialize monorepo with build tooling
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a properly configured monorepo so that I can build and test all packages.
acceptanceCriteria: Root package.json with pnpm workspaces configuration
turbo.json for build orchestration across packages
tsconfig.base.json with shared TypeScript compiler options
pnpm build runs across all packages

userStories.title: Create @unknit/core package structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the core package scaffolding so that I can implement the parser and utilities.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/core/package.json with correct name and dependencies

userStories.title: Define core type system
userStories.description: As a developer, I need TypeScript interfaces for unknit AST nodes so that all packages share a consistent data model.
acceptanceCriteria: SourceRef interface with file, startLine, endLine properties
UnknitNode interface with type, name, params, returnType, sourceRef, children
UnknitFile interface with source path and functions array
ValidationDiagnostic interface with severity, message, range
NodeType enum: fn, block, call, external_call, early_exit, return, error_handler

userStories.title: Implement unknit tokenizer
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a tokenizer that breaks unknit syntax into tokens so that the parser can build an AST.
acceptanceCriteria: Tokenizer handles identifiers and optional markers (?)
Returns array of Token objects with type, value, line, column
Unit tests for each token type

userStories.title: Implement unknit parser for function definitions
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to parse function definition lines into AST nodes.
acceptanceCriteria: Parses return type with optional error type (type | error)
Unit tests for various function signatures

userStories.title: Implement unknit parser for blocks and calls
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to parse block hierarchy, calls, and returns into the AST.
acceptanceCriteria: Parses internal calls name() as 'call' node type
Parses external calls @name() as 'external_call' node type
Parses early exits *-> as 'early_exit' node type
Parses error handlers on error: as 'error_handler' node type
Builds correct parent-child relationships based on indentation

userStories.title: Implement source reference extraction in parser
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the parser to extract and attach source references to AST nodes.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests for source reference parsing

userStories.title: Implement parse error handling
userStories.description: As a developer, I need meaningful error messages when parsing fails so that invalid syntax can be corrected.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns ParseError with line number and column
Error message describes what was expected vs found
Parser recovers and continues after error when possible
Collects multiple errors in single parse attempt
Unit tests for various error cases

userStories.title: Implement unknit serializer
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to convert AST back to .unknit text so that generated/updated files can be written to disk.
acceptanceCriteria: Converts UnknitNode tree to valid unknit syntax
Preserves correct indentation hierarchy (2 spaces per level)
Round-trip test: parse -> serialize -> parse produces identical AST
Unit tests for all node types

userStories.title: Implement source file existence validator
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to validate that source files referenced in unknit exist.
acceptanceCriteria: Loads source file path from SourceRef
Reports error if source file doesn't exist
Reports error if line numbers exceed file bounds

userStories.title: Implement source coverage validator
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to validate that all source lines are covered by unknit blocks.
acceptanceCriteria: Detects overlapping source references (same line covered twice)
Detects gaps in coverage (source lines not mapped)
Returns ValidationDiagnostic with severity 'warning' for coverage issues
Unit tests for overlap and gap scenarios

userStories.title: Implement source-to-block mapper
userStories.description: As a developer, I need bidirectional mapping between source lines and unknit blocks.
acceptanceCriteria: getBlockPath(file, line) returns ancestor chain from root to leaf
Builds optimized line-to-block index for O(1) lookup
Unit tests for all mapping functions

userStories.title: Implement smart updater for line shifts
userStories.description: As a developer, I need automatic line number updates when source code changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Detects line insertions (diff shows added lines)
Detects line deletions (diff shows removed lines)
Preserves user edits to block names
Unit tests for insertion and deletion scenarios

userStories.title: Implement structural change detection
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to detect when source changes require LLM regeneration.
acceptanceCriteria: Detects function added (new function not in unknit)
Detects function removed (unknit references missing function)
Unit tests for structural change scenarios

userStories.title: Create @unknit/generate package structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the generate package scaffolding so that I can implement LLM-based generation.

userStories.title: Implement project configuration loader
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to load project configuration for internal vs external package classification.
acceptanceCriteria: Loads .unknit.yaml from project root using yaml library
Returns sensible defaults when no config file exists

userStories.title: Implement package auto-detection
userStories.description: As a developer, I need automatic detection of internal packages from project manifests.
acceptanceCriteria: Auto-detects Python internal packages from pyproject.toml
Auto-detects JS/TS internal packages from package.json workspaces
Merges auto-detected with manually configured packages
Unit tests for Python and JS/TS projects

userStories.title: Implement source code reader for Python
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to extract metadata from Python source files for LLM context.
acceptanceCriteria: Extracts function boundaries (def statements with start/end lines)
Classifies imports as internal vs external using config

userStories.title: Implement source code reader for TypeScript
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to extract metadata from TypeScript/JavaScript source files.
acceptanceCriteria: Extracts function boundaries (function declarations, arrow functions, methods)
Classifies imports as internal vs external using config

userStories.title: Implement LLM prompt builder
userStories.description: As a developer, I need well-structured prompts for accurate unknit generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Creates condensed unknit spec for system prompt
Builds system prompt with spec + generation rules
Builds user prompt with source code and metadata
Includes function boundaries as generation hints
Adds few-shot examples for consistent output

userStories.title: Implement Anthropic LLM client
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an LLM client to transform source code into unknit format.
acceptanceCriteria: Initializes Anthropic SDK client with API key from environment
Handles API errors with retry logic (3 attempts)
Returns raw unknit string or generation errors
Integration tests with mocked API responses

userStories.title: Implement generation orchestrator
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an end-to-end generator to create unknit files from source.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads source file and extracts metadata
Parses and validates unknit output using core parser
Returns GenerationResult with success status and any errors

userStories.title: Create @unknit/vscode package structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the VS Code extension scaffolding.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/vscode/package.json with VS Code extension manifest
Extension loads in VS Code Extension Development Host

userStories.title: Implement custom editor provider registration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to register a custom editor for .unknit files.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify in VS Code Extension Development Host

userStories.title: Implement custom editor HTML rendering
userStories.description: As a user, I want .unknit files to display as formatted HTML in the editor.
acceptanceCriteria: Parses .unknit file content on document open
Generates HTML with styled blocks for each AST node
Applies CSS for syntax highlighting (fn keyword, calls, returns)
Verify in VS Code Extension Development Host

userStories.title: Implement block expand/collapse UI
userStories.description: As a user, I want to click blocks to expand and see source code.
acceptanceCriteria: Each block has clickable expand/collapse chevron icon
Collapsed state shows unknit summary only
Clicking chevron sends message to extension host
Expand/collapse icons update (right arrow vs down arrow)
Verify in VS Code Extension Development Host

userStories.title: Implement source code display on expand
userStories.description: As a user, I want expanded blocks to show the actual source code inline.
acceptanceCriteria: Extension reads source file using SourceRef
Extracts lines from startLine to endLine
Webview displays source with syntax highlighting
Toggle state persists during editing session
Verify in VS Code Extension Development Host

userStories.title: Implement Go to Source navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to jump from unknit block to source code location.
acceptanceCriteria: Double-click or context menu 'Go to Source' on block
Works for all block types with SourceRef
Verify in VS Code Extension Development Host

userStories.title: Implement Go to Unknit navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to navigate from source code to the unknit block.
acceptanceCriteria: Command available when cursor in source file with .unknit counterpart
Uses mapper to find block for current line
Opens .unknit file and scrolls to corresponding block
Verify in VS Code Extension Development Host

userStories.title: Implement unknit.generate command
userStories.description: As a user, I want a command to generate unknit file for current source.
acceptanceCriteria: Command available when editing Python or TS/JS file
Verify in VS Code Extension Development Host

userStories.title: Implement unknit.validate command
userStories.description: As a user, I want a command to validate unknit file mappings.
acceptanceCriteria: Runs core validator on current .unknit file
Displays validation results in output channel
Verify in VS Code Extension Development Host

userStories.title: Implement unknit.sync command
userStories.description: As a user, I want a command to sync unknit file after source changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Runs smart updater to adjust line numbers
Shows notification if structural changes detected
Verify in VS Code Extension Development Host

userStories.title: Implement validation diagnostics display
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see validation errors inline in the editor.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid source references show as red underlines
Coverage gaps show as yellow warnings
Verify in VS Code Extension Development Host

userStories.title: Implement source file watcher
userStories.description: As a user, I want unknit files to auto-update when source changes.
acceptanceCriteria: FileSystemWatcher monitors source files with .unknit counterparts
On source save: runs smart updater
Shows notification when structural change detected
Verify in VS Code Extension Development Host

userStories.title: Package VS Code extension
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the extension packaged for distribution.
acceptanceCriteria: vsce packaging configured in package.json scripts
Extension installs from vsix in fresh VS Code
All commands work in packaged extension
